mapper.select: SELECT forecast.base_asset, forecast.expected_salary, goal.target_amount, profile.discharge_date, COALESCE(saving.monthly_amount, 0) AS mandatory_saving_amount, COALESCE(saving.interest_rate, 0) AS saving_interest_rate, COALESCE(saving.government_support_expected, 0) AS government_support_expected FROM cashflow_forecast forecast INNER JOIN soldier_profile profile ON profile.user_id = forecast.user_id INNER JOIN goal ON goal.user_id = forecast.user_id AND goal.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN soldier_saving saving ON saving.user_id = forecast.user_id WHERE forecast.forecast_id = ( SELECT latest.forecast_id FROM cashflow_forecast latest WHERE latest.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY latest.generated_at DESC, latest.forecast_id DESC LIMIT 1 )
